Balance/capacity and primal residuals are PCE. The dual residual is rho times the consensus change and is in minutes: rho has min/PCE units. The dotted scientific feasibility gate is 1e-5 PCE; the internal thresholds are the recorded values. The objective gate line is the unchanged 1e-4 relative criterion expressed on the absolute-error axis. Only exact-zero feasibility values use a display value of 1e-16 PCE; every positive value, including smaller positives, is retained unchanged. The vertical separator is after C1 outer 38; C2a contributes 132 further updates under its disclosed new wall budget. The actual trace ends at 170; the registered 300-outer ceiling is not an extrapolated trace. Final own-x objective is 43.66974694298355 PCE·min against LP 43.66742440800644 PCE·min, absolute difference 0.00232253497711 PCE·min and relative difference 0.00531869%. Objective agreement is separate from physical-link flow agreement. No smoothing, interpolation or solver call.
